(vṛddha)upendrayatīndra(ºsarasvatī)
preceptor of Sarveśvarādhvarin, son of Veṅkaṭādhvarin an. brother of Tirumalayajvan (a. of C. Sumanoramā on Siddhāntakamudī). Adyar D. VI. 354. MT. 1281. TD. 5649.

(Vṛddha)garga
jy. writer. mentioned in Mahābhārata (IX. 37. 14-17; XII. 59. 111).
--Utpātaśānti (attributed).
See NCC. II. p. 318a.
Q. in Nirṇayasindhu.

(Vṛddha)Vāgbhaṭa_I
son of Siṃhagupta alias Saṅghagupta an. grandson of Vāgbhaṭa, a Buddhist. Identical prob. with the a. ment. by Itsing. Q. in Yogaratnākara, IO. 2709; by Kṣemaśarman, in his Kṣemakutūhala, IO. 2735; by Śivadāsa in Jyotirnibanda, IO. 3000; in Laṅghanapathyanirṇaya, BORI. D. XVI. 1. 235; q. in Ṭoḍarānanda, Weber 941; in Bhāvaprakāśa, Oxf. 311b.
For more ref. on a cultured study of the works of the two writers see Acarya Priyavrata Sarma, Vāgbhaṭa-vivecana, Chaukhamba, 1968; for a study see ZDMG. 54 (1900) 260-74; also see J.. 9th Ser. XVIII (Jul.-Dec. 1901). 147-81. [Page29b]
-Aṣṭāṅgasaṅgraha. in 150 chs. of which 50 chs. from Uttara. See under the text.
Addl. mss.:
Lakṣmīsena p. 13. Mandlik Sup. 180. Paliyam 789. Ranbir III. p. 792 (inc.). SB. New D.. XII. ii. 108196. Sukṛtīndra I. 1253-54 (inc.). Trav. Uni. Sup. 14787. 15143.

(Vṛddha)Śātātapasmṛti
in diff. verses. Alwar 1478. Andhra Uni. 703 (in a collection). Calcutta Uni. 275. IO. 1360 (97 v.). 5433-34 (68 v.). VVRI. I. p. 304.
-beg. vRddha zAtAtapaproktaM smRtitrayaM vinizcayaM … Rgb. 250. Stein 104.
